label_view.name: scifact-evidence
label_view.rule: Only documents explicitly annotated SUPPORT or CONTRADICT count as relevant; questions without either are excluded uniformly before comparing models.

confidence_method: 5000 bootstrap samples; whole conversations for LoCoMo, queries for SciFact; 95% percentile interval
cost_basis: API reported tokens × published list rate; excludes credits and failed-request billing
